sourcePins.method: Pinned Canisius/eBible source numbering, STEP TVTMS conditional versification audit, and direct semantic review for source-specific exceptions. This is a locator crosswalk, not a claim that translations have identical wording. TVTMS tests identify candidate schemes; semantic review overrides word-count heuristics (notably Philippians1:16–17).

tvtms.attribution: STEPBible.org, Tyndale House, Cambridge; TVTMS – Translators’ Versification Traditions; CC BY4.0.
tvtms.changes: Selected applicable rows and inverted them from Dutch source coordinates to English index coordinates; added explicit Canisius exceptions and bounded-context mappings. No TVTMS scripture wording copied.

sourcePins.profile: The eBible nld1939 base uses English chapter/verse coordinates for the66sharedbooks, confirmed against TVTMS conditional rows and every base chapter extent. The assembled Dutch asset replaces Daniel with original Canisius OSIS (Daniel3:24–30→3:91–97,4:1–3→3:98–100,4:4–37→4:1–34). Psalm titles are merged into1; Esther additions appended separately do not renumber the base story. Psa9:30=NotExist is interpreted as absence, as used by TVTMS Psalm scheme discriminator (English Psa9 has20verses).

supplementReview.scope: 176 Catholic person-index reference occurrences; 153 unique Douay-Rheims source passages. Only these explicit ranges are aligned; this is not a general edition-to-edition verse map.
supplementReview.method: Manual parallel reading of the actual bundled DRA and Dutch Catholic passages, including their endpoints and adjacent material where numbering changes. Dutch targets include whole verse rows where sentence boundaries differ. Original person-index source references remain immutable.

note.nl: Gedeeltelijk overeenkomstig: beide teksten noemen de tegenstand tegen Israël onder Salomon. Het Nederlandse vervolg noemt Hadad en Edom; de Engelse tekst spreekt daar over Rezon en Syrië.
note.en: Partial correspondence: both texts describe opposition to Israel during Solomon’s reign. The Dutch continuation concerns Hadad and Edom; the English text there concerns Rezon and Syria.
note.fr: Correspondance partielle : les deux textes décrivent l’opposition à Israël sous Salomon. La suite néerlandaise concerne Hadad et Édom ; le texte anglais y concerne Rézon et la Syrie.

note.nl: Canisius volgt hier een andere tekstoverlevering voor de volgorde van de twee zonen. Daarom opent de volledige gelijkenis, met beide antwoorden en de conclusie.
note.en: Canisius follows a different textual ordering of the two sons. The complete parable opens, including both answers and the conclusion.
note.fr: Canisius suit un autre ordre textuel des deux fils. La parabole complète s’ouvre avec les deux réponses et la conclusion.
